summary.headline: Defense of Cosmic Order
summary.text: Theological defense of studying God’s creation, arguing that the stars’ variety, harmony, ordered motion, and heavenly circle are good works that should not be judged by limited human understanding. The passage invokes Genesis 1:31 and discusses the devil as a self-willed creation opposed to good.
